Load CellTFusion
```{r}
source("~/Documents/CellTFusion_paper/user_projects/src/environment_set.R")
source("~/Documents/CellTFusion_paper/user_projects/src/cell_deconvolution.R")
set.seed(123)
```

Load data
```{r}
megaclusters_entropy = read.csv("../input/MegaClusters_entropy.csv", row.names = 1)
megaclusters_area = read.csv("../input/MegaClusters_area.csv", row.names = 1)
counts = read.csv("../../LungPredict2/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1) 
traitData = read.csv("../../LungPredict2/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv")
deconv = read.csv("../input/Deconvolution_Gobbini.csv", row.names = 1)
counts = counts[,colnames(counts) %in% rownames(megaclusters_entropy)]
counts = counts[,rownames(megaclusters_entropy)]
all.equal(colnames(counts), rownames(megaclusters_entropy))

traitData = traitData %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("N_Raw_matrice_Bulk")
traitData <- traitData[colnames(counts), ]

deconv = deconv[rownames(traitData),]
```

Cell subgroups
```{r}
library(multideconv)
deconv_subgroups = compute.deconvolution.analysis(deconvolution = deconv, 
                                                  corr = 0.7, 
                                                  seed = 123, 
                                                  file_name = "Gobbini", 
                                                  cells_extra = c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3", "Plasma"),
                                                  return = TRUE) 
save(deconv_subgroups, file = "Deconv_subgroups.RData")
```

Normalize counts
```{r}
counts.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

TF activity
```{r}
tfs = compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm)
```

TF network
```{r}
network = compute.WTCNA(tfs, corr_mod = 0.8, clustering.method = "ward.D2", return = T) 
```

Pathways information
```{r}
pathways = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm)
#Association of TFs modules with pathways
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], pathways, "Pathways_Progeny-TFs_Modules", width = 10)
```

Metadata association 
```{r}
coldata = traitData %>%
  dplyr::select(Site_biopsie, PDL1_higher.than_75, Histologie, ECOG, R.NR)

compute.metada.association(network[[1]], coldata, pval = 0.05, width = 10, height = 10) 
compute.metada.association(megaclusters_area, coldata, pval = 0.05, width = 10, height = 10) 
compute.metada.association(megaclusters_entropy, coldata, pval = 0.05, width = 10, height = 10) 
```

Features association 
```{r}
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], megaclusters_area, "TFs-MegaClusters_area", height = 6, width = 10, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(10, 30, 5, 1))
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], megaclusters_entropy, "TFs-MegaClusters_entropy", height = 6, width = 10, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(10, 30, 5, 1))
```

CD8 enrichment deconvolution 
```{r}
load("../input/Deconv_subgroups.RData")
cd8_deconv = deconv_subgroups$`Deconvolution subgroups per cell types`$CD8.cells
compute.modules.relationship(megaclusters_area, cd8_deconv, "CD8-MegaClusters_area", height = 6, width = 10, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(15, 30, 5, 1))
compute.modules.relationship(megaclusters_entropy, cd8_deconv, "CD8-MegaClusters_entropy", height = 6, width = 10, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(15, 30, 5, 1))
compute.metada.association(cd8_deconv, coldata, pval = 0.05, width = 8, height = 10) 
```

CD8 enrichment 
```{r}
load("../input/Spatial_CD8enrich.RData")
data_spatial$Stroma = data_spatial$Stroma[rownames(df_area),]
compute.modules.relationship(df_area, data_spatial$Stroma, "Imaging-MegaClusters_area", height = 6, width = 10, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(10, 30, 5, 1))
compute.modules.relationship(df_entropy, data_spatial$Stroma, "Imaging-MegaClusters_entropy", height = 6, width = 10, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(10, 30, 5, 1))
compute.metada.association(data_spatial$Stroma, coldata[rownames(coldata)%in%rownames(data_spatial$Stroma),], pval = 0.05, width = 10, height = 10) 
```
